steps.en: REPCCS/EHT sends a UPL notice for an unidentified vehicle
steps.id: REPCCS/EHT mengirim notice UPL untuk kendaraan tidak teridentifikasi

steps.en: The UPL notice enters the automated processing workflow
steps.id: Notice UPL masuk ke alur pemrosesan otomatis
steps.why_en: The next stage is set, but the workflow reference is missing and a ticket says UPL processing is not implemented.
steps.why_id: Tahap berikutnya sudah diatur, tapi acuan alurnya tidak ada dan tiket menyebut pemrosesan UPL belum dibuat.

steps.en: OCMS receives the offender's particulars from REPCCS/EHT
steps.id: OCMS menerima data diri offender dari REPCCS/EHT
steps.why_en: The data sent by REPCCS/EHT has no offender name, ID or address at all.
steps.why_id: Data kiriman REPCCS/EHT tidak memuat nama, ID, maupun alamat offender sama sekali.

steps.en: OCMS updates the offender's particulars on the UPL notice
steps.id: OCMS memperbarui data diri offender pada notice UPL
steps.why_en: Only general update tools exist; nothing updates it from REPCCS/EHT as the story says.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada alat ubah data umum; tidak ada yang memperbaruinya dari REPCCS/EHT seperti di story.

steps.en: Automated follow-up runs on the UPL notice once the offender is known
steps.id: Tindak lanjut otomatis berjalan pada notice UPL setelah offender diketahui
steps.why_en: The MHA job runs but skips company offenders; the company-ID lookup job is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Job MHA berjalan tapi tidak memproses offender perusahaan; job cek ID perusahaan dimatikan di produksi.
